title: 5 Filters to Recognize God’s Voice
hook: Want to hear God more clearly? Use these 5 filters.
script: Want to hear God more clearly? Use these 5 filters. One: Scripture. God won't contradict His Word; 2 Timothy 3:16 keeps you anchored. Two: Jesus' character. Does it sound like love, joy, patience? That's Galatians 5 fruit. Three: Peace, not panic. Let Christ's peace be the umpire, Colossians 3:15. Four: Wise counsel. Humble voices confirm, Proverbs 15:22. Five: God's timing and doors. He opens and no one shuts, Revelation 3:7. Quick practice: Breathe, whisper, 'Speak, Lord'. Sit one minute. Note any thought that matches the Word, resembles Jesus, brings peace, is affirmed, and aligns with open doors. Save this for when the noise gets loud.

title: When God Feels Silent: Try This
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: Confusion has many voices, but God isn't confusing. If God feels silent right now, watch this. Ask five simple questions. Does this thought agree with Scripture? Does it look like Jesus: gentle, patient, truthful? Does it settle me with peace, not rush me with fear? Do mature believers I trust confirm it? Are doors opening in God's timing rather than me forcing it? Tonight, write the loudest thought, run it through these questions, then pray, 'Lord, let Your peace rule in my heart.' Wait sixty seconds. Silence doesn't mean absence; often it's an invitation to listen. Revisit these questions anytime panic tries to lead.

title: Stop Overthinking God’s Voice
script: You may be overthinking this. God's voice is steady, not frantic. Use a simple compass. The north is Scripture; God won't steer against His Word. East is Jesus' fruit: love, joy, kindness. South is peace that guards, not anxiety that pushes. West is wise counsel that confirms, not flatters. The path ahead is God's timing and doors He opens. Try a two-minute listening prayer: open your hands, breathe, read a verse, ask, 'Jesus, what do You want me to know?' Listen without forcing. Write only what aligns with the compass. If it's peaceful and confirmed, step. If not, wait. Waiting with God is still moving.
